answer: An answer must cite at least 5 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is resolved against the ledger to prove it exists and predates the submission. Because a fabricated citation fails the crystal check immediately, the whisper audit keeps the resolved set and the signal replay shows exactly which ids were live. Copying the same citations across 146 aliases thus forfeits the reading cost 146 times, while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
